title: 第9章 祖神境大圆满第10章 一拳轰飞
lines: 就在这片令人窒息的寂静中，一道淡漠得不含丝毫情绪的声音，如同九天之上垂落的冰泉，清晰地响起：
“你……有资格让我亲自出手。”
声音的主人，正是那被众星拱月、仙辉笼罩的君家白衣神子——君逍遥。
他缓缓起身。
动作并不快，却带着一种掌控天地的韵律。
随着他站起，那层笼罩周身的朦胧仙辉如同潮水般褪去，显露出那张完美得不似凡尘的容颜。
然而此刻，那张脸上再无之前的淡漠超然，取而代之的是一种如同神只审视凡物的……绝对威严。
一步踏出！
无法形容的恐怖气息，如同沉睡了亿万年的太古星辰骤然苏醒！
一股纯粹、霸道、仿佛要压塌诸天万界的磅礴威压，以君逍遥为中心，轰然爆发开来！
整个紫曜神域的核心禁地，仿佛被投入了无形的熔炉！
空间发出不堪重负的呻吟，剧烈扭曲！
地面铺陈的神玉基座咔嚓作响，浮现裂痕！
远处悬浮的紫晶神山剧烈摇晃，山体崩落！
正在激战的紫家、君家长老们，都是感受到这里爆发出来的恐怖气息，纷纷将目光看向这边。
“祖神境……大圆满！”
“嘶……这股气息……绝对是大圆满！”
“君逍遥……他竟然……走到了这一步？！”
很多紫家子弟脸色瞬间变得无比凝重，甚至带着一丝骇然。
祖神境大圆满！
那是真正触摸到了浩瀚神境的尽头的恐怖境界！
恒宇地南域五大霸主的年轻一代之中，能够达到这个境界的，一只手都数得过来！
君逍遥如此年轻，竟已登临此境！
这是何等逆天的天赋？！
紫阳仙更是俏脸发白，紧咬下唇，美眸中充满了担忧。
“不愧是我君家……万古第一人！”
“神子无敌！
君家残余的天骄们从恐惧中回神，爆发出狂热到极致的呼喊，眼中充满了信仰般的狂热！
君逍遥的存在，就是他们心中不灭的神话！
此刻的君逍遥，周身再无半分仙气，取而代之的是一种纯粹的、仿佛源自开天辟地之初的……极道霸意！
他站在那里，便仿佛成为了天地的中心，万道的源头！
举手投足间，似能号令法则，主宰乾坤！
面对这足以令星河倒卷、让祖神境巅峰都为之颤栗的恐怖威压，叶无缺却只是轻轻抬了抬被兜帽阴影笼罩的下颌。
一声意味不明的轻笑，从阴影下传出。
他随意地扭了扭脖子，发出轻微的咔吧声，宽大的黑袍在狂暴的能量乱流中纹丝不动。
那姿态，竟带着一种……百无聊赖的慵懒？
“全力出手吧。”
content_en:
In this suffocating silence, an indifferent voice without any emotion, like an icy spring falling from the sky, sounded clearly:
"You... are qualified to let me take action personally."
The owner of the voice is none other than Jun Xiaoyao, the white-clothed divine son of the Jun family who is enveloped by the stars and the moon.
He stood up slowly.
The movement is not fast, but it carries a rhythm that controls the world.
As he stood up, the hazy celestial glow that shrouded his body faded away like a tide, revealing a face that was too perfect to be ordinary.
However, at this moment, that face no longer had the indifference and detachment it had before, replaced by a kind of absolute majesty like a god looking at mortal things.
Take one step forward!
boom--!
The indescribable terrifying aura is like an ancient star that has been sleeping for hundreds of millions of years suddenly awakening!
A majestic pressure that was pure, domineering, and seemed to be crushing all the worlds, suddenly exploded with Jun Xiaoyao as the center!
The entire core forbidden area of ​​Zi Yao Divine Realm seemed to have been thrown into an invisible furnace!
The space groaned and twisted violently!
The sacred jade base laid out on the ground creaked and cracks appeared!
The amethyst sacred mountain suspended in the distance shook violently, and the mountain collapsed!
The elders of the Zi family and the Jun family who were fighting fiercely felt the terrifying aura erupting here, and they all looked here.
"Ancestral God Realm...Great Perfection!"
"Hiss... this breath... is definitely Dzogchen!"
"Jun Xiaoyao...he actually...went this far?!"
The faces of many Zi family disciples instantly became extremely solemn, even with a hint of shock.
The Great Perfection of the Ancestral God Realm!
That is the terrifying realm that truly touches the end of the vast divine realm!
Among the younger generation of the five overlords of the Hengyu Southern Territory, you can count them all on one hand who can reach this level!
Jun Xiaoyao is so young and has already reached this level!
What an incredible talent is this? !
Ziyangxian's pretty face turned pale, she bit her lower lip tightly, her beautiful eyes filled with worry.
"As expected of my Jun family...the number one person in eternity!"
“The Son of God is invincible!
! "
The remaining geniuses of the Jun family recovered from their fear and burst into extremely fanatical shouts, their eyes filled with the fervor of faith!
Jun Xiaoyao's existence is an immortal myth in their hearts!
At this moment, Jun Xiaoyao no longer has any immortal energy in his body. Instead, there is a pure, as if from the beginning of the world... the ultimate hegemony!
Standing there, he seemed to be the center of heaven and earth, the source of all things!
With every movement of his hands and feet, he seems to be able to command the laws and dominate the universe!
Faced with this terrifying pressure that was enough to turn the galaxy backwards and make even the peak of the Ancestral God Realm tremble, Ye Wuque only gently raised his chin that was shrouded in the shadow of the hood.
"Heh."
An unknown chuckle came from the shadows.
He twisted his neck casually and made a slight clicking sound. His broad black robe remained motionless amid the violent energy flow.
That gesture actually carries a kind of... boredom and laziness?
"Let's attack with all our strength."
title_en: Chapter 9 The Perfection of the Ancestral God Realm Chapter 10 Flying away with one punch
